visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four individuals, comprising two women and two men, pose for a group portrait in front of a vintage black BMW convertible inside a spacious garage with a distinctive wooden ceiling. The woman in the center wears a white long-sleeved top and vibrant red high-waisted shorts, while the other woman wears a white skirt and a grey jacket. Both women sport matching teal caps. The men stand on either side, dressed in navy blue polo shirts with visible brand logos. (2) The scene shifts to a series of montage shots outdoors on a sunny day. The two women are seen smiling and laughing while sitting inside the open-top vintage vehicle, wearing sunglasses and their signature teal caps. Detailed close-up shots showcase the car's engine under an open hood within a professional workshop setting. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the polished black exterior and leather straps of the classic BMW 328. (3) Several male staff members in branded BMW Group Classic apparel are shown actively working on the car in a parking area. They are seen checking the spare tire mounted on the rear and manually pushing the vehicle. One man in a black polo and sunglasses smiles broadly at the camera while gesturing near the car's door. The sequence captures the hands-on preparation and care involved in handling these classic automobiles.
